purpose: Prove or falsify a default-off GLM live-resume fix for the BPE-junction disk-checkpoint/long-suffix failure without weakening the global resume guard.

allowed: A production-path test that enters the real server request matcher, disk-KV loader, GLM session sync, and logit path.
A logged DS4_GLM_LIVE_REWIND_V1 flag that defaults off.
The smallest GLM-only lineage/frontier change needed for a branch-matched suffix to resume correctly.
forbidden: Treating token equality, byte equality, or projected TTFT as a substitute for full-logit comparison.
Using the unsafe legacy f13 scripts as runtime launchers.
Changing expert-cache, quantization, prefetch, model, tokenizer, or sampling behavior.

authoritative_prior_red.fixture_shape: A live BPE-junction miss followed by a shorter disk checkpoint and a long suffix, compared with a fresh evaluation of the same complete 5066-token prompt at the same final position.

current_source_snapshot.existing_guard: DS4_GLM_RESUME_GUARD_OFF is absent by default; extension or divergence after a shortened checkpoint forces the proven cold path.
current_source_snapshot.existing_server_behavior: Exact token-prefix and rendered-text-prefix continuations exist; canonical suffix replacement still reports REBUILD_NEEDED and may load an older disk checkpoint.

arms.description: Fresh server, empty private KV directory, complete prompt evaluated to the final position.
Unchanged default strict guard after the prime request; establishes correct-or-cold behavior and proves the guard remains effective.
Same frozen binary and fixture with DS4_GLM_LIVE_REWIND_V1=1; all unrelated environment values byte-identical to STRICT.

fixture_contract.primary: Reproduce the preserved 5044/5066/22 BPE-junction regime exactly before implementation.
fixture_contract.confirmation: After source and binary freeze, use fresh public randomness to choose at least two suffix texts from a committed candidate-independent generator; each must reproduce common < live and a branch-matched suffix longer than four tokens.
fixture_contract.pairing: All arms use byte-identical complete prompt text and token IDs for each fixture. Full logits are compared only at the same final prompt position.
negative_controls: Exact replay of the already evaluated lineage remains byte-identical.
A deliberately non-branch-matched suffix remains rejected by the strict guard and takes the cold path.
A shorter or malformed disk checkpoint cannot be reported as the selected common-prefix checkpoint.

required_raw_observations: Complete prompt text SHA-256 and full token-id dump per arm.
Server-computed live length, common prefix, selected checkpoint length, suffix length, and named sync branch.
Full final-position float32 logit dump and argmax per arm.
Complete session/checkpoint dump sufficient to compare the selected lineage and restored frontier.
Externally observed token timestamps, process/binary identity, memory samples, cgroup events, swap, Xid/OOM, and wrapper terminal record.

fixed_acceptance.comparison: CANDIDATE versus COLD for full dumps/logits/argmax; STRICT and both negative controls establish that default behavior and the global guard are not weakened.
fixed_acceptance.failure_rules: Missing dumps, unequal prompts or token IDs, wrong final positions, incomplete logits, scorer failure, timeout, short output, OOM/Xid, swap growth, survivor, or unavailable memory below 10 GiB is FAIL.
fixed_acceptance.performance_reporting: Warm append TTFT and evaluated suffix tokens are reported, but cannot override a failed correctness check. No projected TTFT is labeled measured.

sequence: Review this plan and the production-path RED design with the two persistent reviewers.
Commit the production-path test and reproduce the inherited RED on unchanged code under containment.
Implement only behind DS4_GLM_LIVE_REWIND_V1=1 and preserve default strict behavior.
Clean-build with at most two jobs, freeze hashes, obtain fresh public randomness, and run the confirmation arms.
Score through the registered W7 formula and preserve every attempt.
Do not relax the default guard or promote the flag without an owner decision on the completed evidence.
